bundle.label: Cross-agent loop
bundle.description: Your orchestrator agent is the brain: it picks the skills a task needs and hands work to the other agents you already have signed in, on the plans you already pay for. No API keys to set up.

steps.title: Brief
steps.text: You give rough notes; the orchestrator turns them into a brief another agent can act on.

steps.title: Delegate
steps.text: The orchestrator picks who does what: a read-only second opinion, a build in its own worktree, or an image.

steps.title: Result
steps.text: Every agent ends with the same Outcome and Next step, so the orchestrator can check the work.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.text: The Your Turn inbox shows which results need you. You carry one back as the next brief.

example.prompt: Add an empty state to the task list: when there are no tasks, show an illustration and an 'Add your first task' button. Use what-to-ask to brief Codex, codex-image to have Codex draw the illustration, review it, then use delegate-code to have Codex build the feature in a worktree and review its diff. Use second-opinion for a Gemini second opinion if the diff is risky. End with the your-turn-handoff block.

steps.text: Claude writes the brief for Codex.
Codex draws the illustration; Claude checks its size, style and file.
Codex builds the empty state in a git worktree; Claude reviews the diff and sends fixes or accepts it.
Optional: another model gives a read-only second opinion.
You get one Outcome and one Next step, such as approve: merge.

example.value: The agents hand the task to each other, every step is reviewed, and you decide once, at the end.

skills.label: what-to-ask
skills.description: Turn rough notes or another agent's result into a prompt.
skills.usage: $what-to-ask Write a prompt for adding CSV export to the filtered table.
skills.example: Use what-to-ask to write a prompt for adding CSV export to the filtered table in Atlas.

skills.label: second-opinion
skills.description: Get an external model opinion through local CLIs.
skills.usage: $second-opinion claude Review my uncommitted changes without editing files.
skills.example: Use second-opinion to get a read-only Claude review of my uncommitted changes.

skills.label: codex-image
skills.description: Delegate image generation to a local Codex CLI.
skills.usage: $codex-image Generate a 1200 × 630 project illustration using Codex.
skills.example: Use codex-image to generate a project illustration using Codex.

skills.label: delegate-code
skills.description: Hand a coding task to Codex, Claude or Antigravity in a worktree and review the diff.
skills.usage: $delegate-code Have Codex add CSV export to the filtered table, then review its diff.
skills.example: Use delegate-code to have Codex add CSV export to the filtered table and review its diff.

skills.label: your-turn-handoff
skills.description: Add a clear result and next step to agent replies.
skills.usage: $your-turn-handoff Use the handoff format for replies in this chat.
skills.example: Use your-turn-handoff for the final answers in this chat.
